evidence: Sander M. Goldberg's Roman literature books and articles account for about 15/20 listed thesis-work citations. British Antiquity, The Lisbon Earthquake, A History of the Vikings, Mary of Agreda, The Druids and the Channel Islands archaeology are Thomas Downing Kendrick's. Sir Robert Walpole, the Old Whigs and the Bishops is explicitly by T. F. J. Kendrick (2/14 listed thesis-work citations); the other fragments fit the archaeologist's books.

Porticus Vipsania is Connie Rodriguez's, Género y currículo is Carmen Rodríguez Martínez's, and Caracalla et les Alexandrins is Chris Rodriguez's. The zero-weight exchange-rate papers involve Carlos Alfredo Rodríguez; Actas remains unresolved.

Empire at the Margins, Lineage, Market, Pirate and Dan, Agents and Victims, Where Were the Women, Tracing China and Down to Earth are Helen F. Siu's works; she also contributed to Locating China. Job Polarization and Jobless Recoveries is by Nir Jaimovich and Henry E. Siu. Chahannaoer xinggong is by Dang Baohai; Shiliu fang remains unresolved. About 18/21 listed thesis-work citations fit Helen.

Justus von Liebig, the Norton/Fontana History of Chemistry, From Protyle to Proton and the science-history articles account for about 11/15 listed thesis-work citations by William H. Brock. Economics of Special Interest Politics is William A. Brock's (2); Scotus Americanus and the 1963 Reconstruction fragment belong to William Ranulf Brock (1 each).

The Rise of Russia, the two Faces of Russian Nationalism entries, The New Russian Nationalism and Russia in Search of an Identity give John B. Dunlop about 7/19 listed thesis-work citations. The Book of Old Edinburgh is John Charles Dunlop's with Alison Hay Dunlop; the diet study is James Craufurd Dunlop's. The colonial letters involve J. G. Dunlop, and the Territorial Army works are John K. Dunlop's.
